body.name: banked heavy-light lift compatibility handle
body.construction: Instantiate the explicit clipped linear-mark Chebyshev factorial estimator from CausalSmithHeterogeneityFrontier2026, \(thm:robust\text{-}upper\text{-}construction\text{-}resolution\), after applying it to the rescaled marks \(Y/2\) and multiplying its output by two. Rewrite its light branch through \(u_k\) as a degree-\(L_n\) element of \(\mathscr Q_{L_n}\) on dyadic slices of \(\mathcal K_{\epsilon,M}(B)\); retain its independent pilot choice \(\widehat{\mathcal L}\), fixed-multinomial falling-factorial recurrence, single independent outcome mark, zero fallbacks, and clipping, and expose the resulting light statistic as \(\widehat T_{\mathrm L}\) for direct tail calibration.
